releases.title: Chart emphasis, motion, and settings pass
releases.summary: Normalizes live and offline chart bar emphasis, restores VOD chart motion, replaces the Games played pop-out with an inline label, and adds clear-cache plus reduce-motion controls.
new: Options page can clear cached Pulse and coverage snapshots (same path as a build-id change).
Reduce motion preference (System / On / Off) in sidebar settings; System keeps the previous OS default.
Privacy policy link in the advanced options footer.
improved: Chart bar emphasis uses an absolute state table so rest, future, dimmed, and active buckets stay consistent.
Games played keeps the full game name in the header with a stable nav trail, plus a chip-local name overlay as a locator, and a pinned suffix when a game is selected.
fixed: Offline/VOD recap charts no longer force reduced motion; crosshair glide and opacity fades match live when motion is allowed.
knownIssues: Chrome still requires a manual reload of the unpacked extension after a build; a changed dist directory alone does not reinject Twitch content.
A live stream may not expose a VOD id until Twitch publishes the archive after the stream ends.

releases.title: Private beta preview - local reliability pass
releases.summary: A preview of the current extension and analytics work. This entry is not a released version; it documents the build currently available to local testers.
new: A public changelog is now available from the extension settings and StreamPulse site footer.
Games Played can use compact game artwork with accessible hover and keyboard labels.
Release builds expose a build identity and package-cohort provenance for troubleshooting stale bundles.
improved: Jump-in-player now distinguishes archived VOD seeking from live DVR seeking and reports the path it attempted.
Settings now show the installed extension version, connection mode, and a direct link to release notes.
Local extension delivery checks the canonical unpacked path and requires an explicit handoff before Chrome reload.
fixed: Reduced confusing stale-bundle reports by checking artifact freshness against source and release-note inputs.
Added clearer diagnostics for VOD discovery, archive availability, and hosted persistence authentication.
knownIssues: This preview is not a production release and may include dirty local package cohorts.
Chrome still requires a manual reload of the unpacked extension after a build; a changed dist directory alone does not reinject Twitch content.
A live stream may not expose a VOD id until Twitch publishes the archive after the stream ends.
